title: Builder Project Detail Page
description: Comprehensive project detail page for builder projects featuring image gallery with navigation, RERA certification badge, unit types table, floor plans, embedded Google Maps, Panditji AI Score, nearby places, enquiry modal, similar projects carousel, and social sharing capabilities.
features: Image gallery with next/prev navigation and counter
Units table (BHK, Size, Price, Status) from project.units array
Floor plans section with downloadable links
Embedded Google Maps for project location
Panditji AI Score (0-10) with color-coded badge
Nearby Places (schools, hospitals, metro, shopping centers)
Modal-based enquiry form with success state
Fixed API signature mismatches for getSimilarProjects and submitProjectEnquiry
acceptance_criteria: Image gallery navigable with keyboard and mouse
Maps iframe loads with correct coordinates
Enquiry form validates and submits to backend
result_summary: Complete project detail page implemented with all requested features. Image gallery, units table, floor plans, maps, AI score, nearby places, enquiry form, and similar projects all functional. API signature issues resolved. Builds with zero errors and full dark mode support.
